items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: Frankie Deucer was playing trambone with Buddy Bolden.

ctx.x: You see Mania? Mania was a tripper player. Buddy Bolden Sharp. He was afraid, huh? He was scared, sure, because Frankie Deucer was playing trambone with Buddy Bolden. Bob Lyon was trying to shoot on Rampard Street, he was a bass player. And that's all I'm going to tell you now. I'm glad you all come meet me and see, and I appreciate that you all, actually I'm going to have a little talk, but I'm not much of a speaker. Oh we like it.
